The change adds:
- `RETRY_WINDOW_SECONDS = 30` constant (from API-482 acceptance criteria)
- A retry loop in `rotate_token` that keeps retrying on `TimeoutError` until the 30-second deadline is exceeded, then raises `TokenRotationError`
- Permanent failures (e.g. `ValueError` for bad token format) fall through uncaught and propagate immediately — satisfying the "don't hide permanent validation failures" criterion
- Token format/interface is unchanged, preserving legacy client compatibility
